# LogistiCore Technologies

> LogistiCore SaaS is an international freight forwarding and logistics platform — air, sea, road, courier, warehouse, customs (including UK HMRC CDS), billing and AI. UK-headquartered; built for logistics teams worldwide. Complementary IT support and website services available.

- Site: https://logisticoreapp.com
- Platform: https://logisticoreapp.com/logisticore-saas.html
- App login: https://app.logisticoreapp.com/app/login
- Sales: sales@logisticoreapp.com
- Support: support@logisticoreapp.com
- Phone: +44 (0) 20 4511 4156
- Markets: Worldwide (English); UK HQ

## Primary product

- [LogistiCore SaaS / Platform](https://logisticoreapp.com/logisticore-saas.html): Freight forwarding software for forwarders, brokers, and 3PLs internationally
- [Freight software guide](https://logisticoreapp.com/freight-software.html): Freight management software capabilities, selection guidance, and FAQs
- [Partner programme](https://logisticoreapp.com/partners.html): Reseller, referral, implementation, and technology partnerships worldwide
- [Pricing](https://logisticoreapp.com/pricing.html)
- [Contact / book a demo](https://logisticoreapp.com/contact.html?enquiry=saas)
- [Results & use cases](https://logisticoreapp.com/results.html): Operational scenarios for forwarders, brokers and 3PLs
- [Press kit](https://logisticoreapp.com/press-kit.html): Boilerplate, facts and brand assets for partners and directories
